faqs.q: When should I see a dermatologist?
faqs.a: For any skin, hair or nail problem that lasts more than a couple of weeks, keeps coming back or worries you — rashes, acne, pigmentation, infections, hair fall or changing moles. A dermatologist can diagnose precisely and treat the cause.

faqs.q: Do you treat children?
faqs.a: Yes. Paediatric dermatology is a special interest of Dr. Eshritha C, and we see babies, children and teenagers for eczema, infections, birthmarks, warts, acne and more.

faqs.q: Are consultations for sexual health and STDs confidential?
faqs.a: Yes. Consultations for sexually transmitted diseases and other sexual problems are private and handled with complete confidentiality.

faqs.a: Procedures are done under local anaesthesia or numbing cream, so most people feel only the initial numbing. Any soreness afterwards is usually mild.

faqs.q: Will there be a scar?
faqs.a: Procedures are planned to minimise marks, and many leave little or no visible scar once healed. Your dermatosurgeon will explain what to expect for your specific procedure.

faqs.q: How long do the procedures take?

faqs.q: What causes hair fall?
faqs.a: Common causes include genetic pattern hair loss, hormonal changes (including PCOS and after childbirth), low iron or vitamin levels, thyroid problems, stress, crash dieting and scalp conditions. Finding the cause is the first step.

faqs.q: How long do hair treatments take to work?
faqs.a: Hair grows slowly, so most treatments take three to six months to show a visible change. Starting early gives the best results.

faqs.q: Do you treat women’s hair loss?
faqs.a: Yes. Female hair loss often has hormonal or nutritional causes, so we tailor the work-up and treatment plan for women.

faqs.a: Dr. Jatin K Reddy — MBBS, MD (DVL), consultant dermatologist and hair transplant surgeon with a fellowship in hair transplantation.

faqs.q: Which technique is right for me?
faqs.a: It depends on the area to be covered, the density you want and your donor hair. FUE (including Sapphire Bio FUE) covers larger areas efficiently; DHI gives fine control for hairlines and dense packing. We recommend the best fit after a scalp assessment.

faqs.q: How long is the recovery?
faqs.a: Most people return to desk work in 3–5 days. Small crusts clear in about 10 days, new growth begins around month 3–4, and the final result shows at 9–12 months.

faqs.q: Why does my acne keep coming back?

faqs.q: Is psoriasis contagious?
faqs.a: No. Psoriasis is an immune-related condition and cannot spread from person to person.

faqs.q: Can eczema be cured?

faqs.q: What are biologics?
faqs.a: Biologics are advanced medicines that target specific parts of the immune system. They are considered for moderate to severe psoriasis and some other conditions when other treatments are not enough.

faqs.q: What is PDRN or “salmon DNA”?
faqs.a: PDRN is a purified polynucleotide derived from salmon DNA. It is used in dermatology to support skin repair and regeneration, and is injected in tiny amounts by a doctor.

faqs.q: Are skin boosters the same as fillers?
faqs.a: No. Boosters spread through the skin to improve hydration and quality; fillers add volume or shape to specific areas.

faqs.q: How long do the results last?
faqs.a: Typically a few months. A maintenance session every few months keeps the effect.

treatments.summary: Botulinum toxin (“Botox”) relaxes specific muscles to soften expression lines, while hyaluronic-acid dermal fillers restore volume and refine contours. At RUA both are performed by dermatologists, with a conservative approach that keeps your expressions natural. Thread lifts are also available for lifting and contouring.

facts.label: Filler results

treatments.results: Botox softens lines within a week and lasts around three to four months. Fillers show immediately and last for months, depending on the area and product.
treatments.cost: Priced by product, units or syringes, and area. You receive a clear quote after your facial assessment.

faqs.q: Will I look frozen?
faqs.a: Not with a conservative, well-placed dose. Our aim is to soften lines while keeping natural expression.

faqs.q: Are fillers reversible?
faqs.a: Hyaluronic-acid fillers can be dissolved with an enzyme if needed.

faqs.q: Is Botox safe?
faqs.a: In qualified hands and at cosmetic doses, botulinum toxin has a long safety record. Your dermatologist reviews your medical history first.

treatments.name: Laser Hair Reduction

seo.title: Laser Hair Removal in Bangalore – Triple Wavelength | RUA
seo.description: Triple-wavelength diode laser hair reduction for face and body, suited to Indian skin — dermatologist-supervised, with lifetime packages, at RUA, Bengaluru.

treatments.summary: Laser hair reduction uses light energy to disable hair follicles, so unwanted hair grows back finer and sparser. RUA uses a triple-wavelength diode laser, which combines three wavelengths to treat different hair depths and skin types — including Indian skin — under dermatologist supervision.
whoFor: Unwanted facial hair — upper lip, chin and jawline
Underarms, arms, legs and bikini line
Beard shaping, back and chest for men
Hormonal hair growth such as PCOS, alongside medical care

steps.title: Treat
steps.text: Quick laser pulses with built-in cooling for comfort.

steps.title: Maintain
steps.text: Sessions spaced to the hair cycle, plus occasional maintenance.

treatments.results: Most people notice finer, sparser regrowth after the first few sessions. Laser gives long-term reduction rather than a guarantee of permanent removal — hormonal areas may need occasional maintenance sessions.
treatments.cost: Priced by area and number of sessions. Lifetime laser hair reduction packages are available, with EMI options.

faqs.q: Is laser hair removal permanent?
faqs.a: It gives long-lasting reduction: treated hair grows back much finer and sparser, and many people need only occasional maintenance. Hormonal areas may need more.

faqs.q: Is it safe for Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes, when the right wavelength and settings are used. Triple-wavelength diode lasers treat a wide range of skin types, and our doctors adjust settings for your skin.

faqs.q: Does it hurt?
faqs.a: Most people describe a quick, warm snap. Built-in cooling keeps it comfortable.

faqs.q: How should I prepare?
faqs.a: Shave the area a day before, avoid waxing, threading or plucking for four weeks, and avoid sun tanning before your sessions.

treatments.name: Laser Tattoo & Pigment Removal

seo.title: Laser Tattoo Removal in Bangalore – Q-Switched Laser | RUA
seo.description: Q-switched Nd:YAG laser tattoo removal and pigment lasers for unwanted tattoos and pigmented marks — by dermatologists at RUA, Bengaluru.

treatments.summary: Laser tattoo removal uses very short pulses of laser energy to break tattoo ink into tiny particles, which your body clears over the following weeks. RUA uses a Q-switched Nd:YAG laser, which is also used for certain pigmented marks and for laser toning.

facts.label: Aftercare
facts.value: Redness or small blisters heal in about a week

whoFor: Lightening a tattoo before a cover-up

steps.title: Test spot
steps.text: A small test area when needed, to choose the right settings.

steps.title: Treat
steps.text: Laser pulses with cooling; each session takes minutes.

steps.title: Heal & repeat
steps.text: Simple aftercare, with sessions spaced for the ink to clear.

treatments.results: Each session lightens the ink further. Amateur and black tattoos usually respond best; dense, multicoloured professional tattoos need more sessions, and some colours may not clear completely.
treatments.cost: Depends on the size, colours and number of sessions. You receive a quote after assessment.

faqs.q: How many sessions will my tattoo need?
faqs.a: It varies with the size, ink colours, depth and age of the tattoo. Most need several sessions spaced six to eight weeks apart.

faqs.q: Does laser tattoo removal leave a scar?
faqs.a: With the right settings and aftercare, scarring is uncommon. Temporary lightening or darkening of the skin can occur and usually settles.

faqs.q: Can eyebrow tattoos be removed?
faqs.a: Yes. Cosmetic brow tattoos can often be lightened or removed, with care taken around the eye area.

treatments.summary: Fractional CO₂ laser resurfacing creates thousands of microscopic treatment zones in the skin, triggering new collagen to smooth acne scars, uneven texture and enlarged pores. RUA’s dermatologists have published research on pinhole CO₂ ablation for papular scars.

treatments.results: Skin looks pink and feels rough for about a week as it heals. Scars soften gradually over the following months as collagen remodels; most people need two to four sessions for a meaningful change.
treatments.cost: Priced per session or as a scar refinement programme, with EMI options.

faqs.q: Is CO₂ laser safe for Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes, with careful settings and preparation. Darker skin has a higher risk of temporary pigmentation, so we prime the skin beforehand and plan conservative settings.

faqs.q: How much downtime should I expect?
faqs.a: Usually five to seven days of redness and fine crusting. Most people plan treatment around a few days of rest from social events.

faqs.q: Can CO₂ laser be combined with other scar treatments?
faqs.a: Yes. Scars often respond best to a combination — such as microneedling RF, chemical peels or scar revision procedures — planned by your dermatologist.

treatments.summary: Effective hair loss treatment starts with the right diagnosis. RUA’s dermatologists examine your scalp, find out why you are losing hair — pattern hair loss, shedding after illness or stress, nutritional or hormonal causes, or alopecia areata — and build a plan that may combine medical treatment with in-clinic therapies.

facts.label: First visit

facts.label: Therapies
facts.value: Medical, PRP, GFC, exosomes, QR678, mesotherapy, LLLT

whoFor: More hair fall than usual, or a widening parting
A receding hairline or thinning crown
Hair loss after illness, childbirth, stress or dieting

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: History, scalp examination and trichoscopy, with blood tests when needed.

steps.title: Treat the cause
steps.text: Medical management of male and female hair loss, tailored to you.

steps.title: Boost regrowth
steps.text: PRP, GFC, exosomes, QR678, scalp mesotherapy, microneedling or LLLT when they are likely to help.

steps.title: Maintain
steps.text: Hair strengthening and maintenance programmes, with periodic reviews.

treatments.results: Hair grows slowly, so most treatments take three to six months to make a visible difference. Early treatment usually gives the best results. For advanced, stable baldness, a hair transplant may be discussed.
treatments.cost: Cost depends on the diagnosis and the therapies chosen. Treatment starts with a consultation; multi-session programmes are available as packages with EMI options.

faqs.q: How much hair fall is normal?
faqs.a: Losing around 50–100 hairs a day is common. If you notice much more hair on your pillow or in the shower, a widening parting or thinning patches, it is worth seeing a dermatologist.

faqs.q: Is hair loss treatment different for women?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Female hair loss can be linked to hormones, iron or thyroid levels, PCOS or childbirth, so the work-up and treatment are tailored.

faqs.q: Do I need PRP or GFC?
faqs.a: Not always. Many people respond well to medical treatment alone; in-clinic therapies are added when they are likely to help. Your dermatologist will advise.

faqs.q: When should I consider a hair transplant?
faqs.a: When hair loss is advanced and stable and you have a good donor area. We assess this honestly at your consultation.

treatments.name: PRP Hair Treatment

seo.title: PRP Hair Treatment in Bangalore – Sessions & Results | RUA
seo.description: Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) therapy for hair fall and thinning, prepared from your own blood and delivered by RUA’s dermatologists in Bengaluru. Packages and EMI.

treatments.summary: PRP (platelet-rich plasma) therapy uses growth factors from your own blood to support weakening hair follicles. A small blood sample is processed to concentrate the platelets, which are then injected into thinning areas of the scalp. It works best for early to moderate thinning and is often combined with medical treatment.

facts.label: Downtime
facts.value: Minimal — mild scalp tenderness for a day

whoFor: Early male or female pattern hair loss
Diffuse thinning and increased hair fall
Supporting growth after a hair transplant
Anyone who prefers a non-surgical option

steps.title: Processing
steps.text: The sample is centrifuged to separate and concentrate the platelet-rich plasma.

steps.title: Scalp preparation
steps.text: The scalp is cleaned and numbed for comfort.

steps.title: Micro-injections
steps.text: PRP is injected evenly into the thinning areas with fine needles.

treatments.results: Many people notice less hair fall first, followed by thicker, stronger hair over three to six months. Results vary with the cause and stage of hair loss; maintenance sessions help sustain them.
treatments.cost: PRP is priced per session or as a multi-session package, with EMI options. Your dermatologist will recommend the number of sessions after assessment.

faqs.q: Is PRP for hair painful?
faqs.a: The scalp is numbed before treatment, so most people feel only mild pressure or pricks. Any tenderness usually settles within a day.

faqs.q: How many PRP sessions will I need?
faqs.a: A typical course is three to four sessions, four to six weeks apart, followed by occasional maintenance sessions.

faqs.q: PRP or GFC — which is better?
faqs.a: Both use growth factors from your own blood. GFC concentrates the growth factors in a cell-free form, which some people find more comfortable. Your dermatologist will suggest the better fit for you.

faqs.q: Who should avoid PRP?
faqs.a: People with certain blood or platelet disorders, an active scalp infection, or on some blood-thinning medicines may not be suitable. We check this at the consultation.

treatments.name: GFC Hair Treatment

seo.title: GFC Hair Treatment in Bangalore – Growth Factor Therapy | RUA
seo.description: Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) therapy for hair thinning — growth factors from your own blood, delivered by RUA’s dermatologists in Bengaluru. Packages and EMI.

treatments.summary: GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate) therapy is an advanced form of platelet therapy. Growth factors are released from your own platelets and concentrated into a cell-free solution, which is delivered into the scalp to strengthen thinning hair and support regrowth.
whoFor: Early to moderate pattern hair loss in men and women
Diffuse thinning and excessive hair fall

steps.title: Blood sample

steps.title: Activation & concentration
steps.text: Growth factors are released from the platelets and concentrated in a cell-free solution.

steps.text: The scalp is cleaned and numbed.

steps.title: Precise delivery
steps.text: GFC is delivered evenly into thinning areas.

treatments.results: Hair fall usually reduces first, with improved thickness and density over the following months. Combined with the right medical treatment, GFC can help maintain your hair long term.
treatments.cost: Priced per session or as a package, with flexible payment and EMI options.

faqs.q: How is GFC different from PRP?
faqs.a: PRP uses concentrated platelets; GFC uses the growth factors released from them, in a cell-free form. Both come from your own blood.

faqs.q: How many GFC sessions do I need?
faqs.a: Most plans start with three to four sessions about a month apart, followed by maintenance sessions as advised.

faqs.q: Is there any downtime after GFC?
faqs.a: Very little. You can usually return to your routine the same day; avoid heavy workouts and hair products for a short time as advised.

seo.description: Scalp micropigmentation (SMP) creates the look of density or a crisp shaved hairline with fine pigment dots — at RUA Skin & Hair Center, Bengaluru.

treatments.summary: Scalp micropigmentation (SMP) is a non-surgical cosmetic technique that places tiny pigment dots in the scalp to mimic hair follicles. It creates the look of fuller hair or a closely shaved head, and can camouflage scars.
whoFor: Diffuse thinning where you want the look of density
Men who prefer a shaved, buzz-cut look
People who are not suited to a transplant

treatments.cost: Priced by area and number of sessions, with EMI options available.

faqs.q: Does SMP look natural?
faqs.a: With the right dot size, depth and shade matched to your skin and hair, SMP looks like natural follicles. It is planned around how you wear your hair.

faqs.q: Does SMP fade?
faqs.a: Pigment softens gradually over the years. A touch-up session refreshes it.

faqs.q: Can SMP be combined with a hair transplant?
faqs.a: Yes. It can add the look of density between transplanted areas or hide donor-area scars.

treatments.name: FUE Hair Transplant
treatments.h1: FUE & Sapphire FUE Hair Transplant in Bangalore

seo.title: FUE Hair Transplant in Bangalore – Sapphire & Bio FUE | RUA
seo.description: FUE, Sapphire Bio FUE and Bio-Enhanced hair transplants by a fellowship-trained hair transplant surgeon at RUA, Bengaluru. Natural hairlines, minimal downtime.

treatments.summary: Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) moves healthy hair follicles one by one from the back of your scalp to areas that are thinning or bald — without a linear scar. At RUA, FUE, Sapphire Bio FUE and Bio-Enhanced transplants are planned and performed by Dr. Jatin K Reddy, a consultant dermatologist with a fellowship in hair transplantation.

facts.label: Anaesthesia
facts.value: Local — you stay awake and comfortable

facts.label: Donor area
facts.value: Tiny dot marks, hidden in short hair

whoFor: Men with stable male-pattern baldness and a good donor area
Women with hairline or crown thinning, after a medical work-up
Anyone who wants to wear short hair without a linear donor scar
Restoring density after an earlier transplant (revision work)

steps.title: Consultation & hairline design
steps.text: Scalp and donor analysis, a graft estimate and a hairline drawn to suit your face, age and future hair loss.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.text: Individual follicular units are harvested with fine micro-punches from the permanent donor zone, under local anaesthesia.

steps.title: Implantation
steps.text: Recipient channels are opened — with sapphire blades in Sapphire FUE — and each graft is placed at a natural angle, direction and density.

steps.title: Aftercare & follow-up
steps.text: Clear washing and sleeping instructions, review visits, and optional PRP or GFC to support healing and growth.

treatments.results: Mild swelling and small crusts settle within 7–10 days. Transplanted hairs usually shed between weeks 2 and 6 — this is expected — before new growth begins around months 3–4. Density keeps improving for up to a year. Medical treatment is often advised alongside, to protect the hair you already have.
treatments.cost: The cost of an FUE transplant depends on the number of grafts, the technique (classic FUE, Sapphire Bio FUE or Bio-Enhanced), the area treated and your donor quality. You receive a graft estimate and a transparent quote after your scalp assessment, with flexible payment and EMI options.

faqs.q: Is an FUE hair transplant permanent?
faqs.a: Follicles taken from the donor zone at the back of the scalp are resistant to pattern hair loss and keep that resistance after transplantation, so results are long-lasting. Your existing, non-transplanted hair can still thin, which is why we plan for the future and often add medical treatment.

faqs.q: Does FUE hurt?
faqs.a: The procedure is done under local anaesthesia, so most people feel only the first numbing injections. Mild soreness for a few days is usually managed with simple medicines.

faqs.q: What is Sapphire Bio FUE?
faqs.a: Sapphire FUE uses sapphire-tipped blades to open the recipient channels, giving fine, smooth incisions for precise graft placement and comfortable healing. Bio-Enhanced techniques add growth-factor therapy to support healing. Your surgeon will advise whether they suit you.

faqs.q: How many grafts will I need?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the area, the density you want and your donor supply. We examine your scalp and give you a graft estimate at the consultation.

treatments.name: DHI Hair Transplant

seo.title: DHI Hair Transplant in Bangalore – Direct Implantation | RUA
seo.description: Direct Hair Implantation (DHI) with implanter pens for dense, natural hairlines — planned and performed by RUA’s fellowship-trained hair transplant surgeon in Bengaluru.

treatments.summary: Direct Hair Implantation (DHI) refines FUE: follicles are extracted the same way, then loaded into an implanter pen and placed directly into the scalp, controlling the depth, angle and direction of every graft. It is especially suited to hairline design, dense packing and corrective work.

facts.label: Shaving
facts.value: Decided at consultation — partial shave may suit small areas

whoFor: Women with hairline or crown thinning, after medical evaluation

steps.title: Assessment & planning
steps.text: Scalp, donor and hair-loss pattern assessment, with a hairline designed for your face.

steps.title: Follicle extraction
steps.text: Grafts are harvested individually by FUE from the permanent donor zone.

steps.title: Direct implantation
steps.text: Each graft is implanted with a pen-like implanter, setting angle, depth and direction one by one.

steps.title: Recovery & reviews
steps.text: Aftercare guidance and review visits, with optional PRP or GFC to support growth.

treatments.results: Healing is similar to FUE: small crusts settle in about 10 days, transplanted hairs shed in the first weeks, and new growth starts around months 3–4. The final density and hairline show at 9–12 months.
treatments.cost: DHI is priced on graft count and complexity. Because every graft is placed with an implanter pen, DHI usually costs more than classic FUE. You receive a written estimate after your assessment, with EMI options available.

faqs.q: Is DHI better than FUE?
faqs.a: Neither is better for everyone. DHI gives fine control for hairlines and dense packing; FUE, including Sapphire Bio FUE, can cover larger areas efficiently. We recommend the technique that suits your hair-loss pattern and goals.

faqs.q: Can DHI be done without shaving?
faqs.a: In selected cases with smaller areas, the recipient area may not need a full shave. This depends on the number of grafts and is decided at your consultation.

faqs.q: When will I see results?
faqs.a: New hairs usually begin to grow around month three to four, with the final result at nine to twelve months.

faqs.a: Prices vary with the number of grafts, the technique and the area treated, so an accurate figure needs a scalp assessment. RUA gives you a graft estimate and a written quote at the consultation, with EMI options available.

faqs.q: Is cost per graft the best way to compare clinics?
faqs.a: It is useful, but also compare who performs the surgery, the technique, the procedure environment and the aftercare included. These have a bigger effect on your result than a small difference in price.

faqs.q: Do you offer EMI for hair transplants?

treatments.summary: Patchy beards, thin moustaches and sparse or scarred eyebrows can be filled with hair follicles taken from your own scalp. Each graft is placed at the exact angle and direction of natural facial hair, for a soft and believable result.

treatments.results: Transplanted hairs shed in the first weeks, then regrow from around month three. Eyebrow hairs come from the scalp and can grow longer than natural brow hair, so they need occasional trimming.

faqs.q: Will a beard transplant look natural?
faqs.a: Yes, when grafts are placed at the right angle and density. We design the beard line and density to match your face and natural hair direction.

faqs.q: Do transplanted eyebrows need trimming?
faqs.a: Yes. They come from the scalp and can grow longer than natural brow hair, so occasional trimming keeps them neat.

faqs.q: When can I shave or trim the area?
faqs.a: Usually after about 10–14 days, once healing is complete. We give you a personalised aftercare schedule.

whyRua.title: Expert skincare
whyRua.text: RUA makes expert skincare both effective and accessible — every plan is personalised by a dermatologist.

whyRua.title: Flexible payment
whyRua.text: Flexible payment options and EMI plans for treatment packages.

whyRua.title: Fellowship-trained doctors
whyRua.text: Three MBBS, MD (DVL) dermatologists with fellowships in hair transplantation, dermatosurgery, lasers & aesthetics, and functional medicine.

whyRua.title: Safe environment
whyRua.text: We maintain a safe and sterile environment for all our treatments, with uncompromised quality and hygiene.

generalFaqs.q: Do I need a consultation before a treatment?
generalFaqs.a: Yes. Every treatment at RUA starts with a consultation with one of our dermatologists, so your plan is right for your skin, hair and health.
Both centres — Ramamurthy Nagar and Indiranagar — are open every day from 10am to 8pm. Choose the one that is easier for you; our team will confirm your doctor’s availability.

generalFaqs.q: Do you offer EMI or payment plans?
generalFaqs.a: Yes. RUA offers flexible payment options and EMI plans for treatment packages. Ask our front desk for the current options.
Yes. All three doctors are MBBS, MD (DVL) dermatologists with fellowship training — in hair transplantation; dermatosurgery, lasers & aesthetic dermatology; and functional & longevity medicine.
